descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S01 「第 6 步端到端：强制 Haiku 失败，病历里每个 AI 步骤（Save Note、Save & Extract、Generate、计费）都由 Mistral 完成，并记录模型（两个模式）」 Step 6 end to end: Haiku forced to fail, every AI step of a chart still works from Mistral (Save Note, Save & Extract, Generate, billing), and the model is recorded (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral（UAT OAT-03 step 6；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3；TFA-94422 AC 2）
  • U7 The output records which model produced it; each run records which AI ran each step (note model, speech-to-text engine, pre-round model, photo model, Ask AI model)（UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3；UAT 3.1；UAT 3.9；TFA-94422 AC 6；TFA-94423 AC 7）
  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; …（UAT OAT-03 step 1；UAT OAT-03 step 2；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT 3.5；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state（UAT OAT-03 step 4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94422 AC 5）
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android（UAT 3.3；UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 6）
  • U10 The fallback model's output is held to the same rules as the primary's: never invent (3.4), and as an AI Check it runs on at least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home) passing at 9/ …（UAT 3.2；UAT 3.4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Local stack only, with BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL set to the Haiku id through a local-only wrapper that sets it on the 4510 deployment and always removes it (the seam in bedrock.invoke makes every Haiku call fail as a 429 throttle before it leaves the process); …

When On each chart: (1) Pre-Round tab: type the pre-round dictation (two labs) and tap Save Note; (2) Encounter tab: type the encounter dictation (it holds a medication and asks for a task) and tap Save & Extract; (3) tap Generate Note & Finish; (4) on Post-Round let the billing suggestion load where the context shows one

Then The pre-round panels show the two dictated lab values and no other lab (3.4); the lisinopril / trazodone row shows Held and a task for the BMP / weekly weight appears; the note appears with the dictated facts and no supplied exam, normals or 'No past medical history documented'; a billing code appears where offered; the dictation is unchanged; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3 + TFA-94422 AC 2 / AC 6 + 3.4. Checkpoints: panels mustContain the two dictated values; Post-Round mustContain the dictated facts ('furosemide 40', 'BMP' / 'trazodone') and mustNotContain the TC-14 S11 stock-exam phrases and the 3.4 phrases. …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S01

Step 6 end to end: Haiku forced to fail, every AI step of a chart still works from Mistral (Save Note, Save & Extract, Generate, billing), and the model is recorded (both contexts)

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status blocked → 卡住（卡住）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: partly）：Needs every Haiku call to fail on the server so Mistral answers (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL); the verdict is the diagnostics/audit rows model=Mistral, fellBackFrom=Haiku. Built path: aicheck-other's scripts/aicheck-other/fault-stack.sh (private backend 5330/5331, gated QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1) + a Vite pointed at it; then this browser case runs there. — Setting the seam is `convex env set`, forbidden by CLAUDE.md without Quinn's explicit OK, and it must never touch the shared 4510 stack (it would break every parallel AI check). A socket-level mock cannot prove a server fallback.

Detail:

Not built as a run: the verdict is the server's fallback rows (model = Mistral, fellBackFrom = Haiku), which need BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL on a backend. That is `convex env set` (forbidden by CLAUDE.md without Quinn's OK) and must never touch the shared 4510 stack. Path: aicheck-other's private fault backend (scripts/aicheck-other/fault-stack.sh, QA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ENV=1) + a Vite pointed at it + QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1.

证据：附了 0 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack: Haiku is made to fail with BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL, a deployment env seam that may never be set on a shared deployment (Q12; convex env set is forbidden on every target), and the audit rows are an admin read (backend-read-admin).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
